title.narrative: Combating Mono-ethnic Journalism and Advocating for the Missing Persons in Kosovo

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to contribute to transforming the discourse surrounding the missing persons issue, paving the way for reconciliation, resolution and mutual understanding, all while advocating for the rights of their families.


The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:


(Oc.1) is Equip journalists with the knowledge and tools necessary for effective, impartial, and sensitive reporting on the issue of missing persons.

Oc.2: To enhance accountability and understanding of the investigative and justice processes by fostering dialogue with institutional stakeholders.
